generated_by: npm run tools:export — do not edit by hand

webhook.body: JSON object with the tool parameters below

tools.name: get_day_info
tools.description: Get the details of one study day (date, hours, location, price, agenda) and the general policies. Call before quoting any detail. Use only a day_id from the catalogue.

day_id.description: Study day id from the closed catalogue in the prompt

tools.name: send_purchase_link
tools.description: Send the customer a purchase link for one study day, to the phone number on file. Call only after the customer agreed to receive a link. Never takes a phone number.

day_id.description: Study day id from the closed catalogue in the prompt

tools.name: schedule_callback
tools.description: Note the customer's request to be called back at the time they asked for. It is a note for the team that calls back - you have no calendar and see no one's schedule. If the time is outside business hours, the response proposes an alternative - confirm it with the customer before ending.

requested_time.description: ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-11-17T10:00:00 (Asia/Jerusalem local time when no offset)

tools.name: request_human
tools.description: Note that a human rep should call the customer back: wants a person, pays via a rep, company pays, asks for a discount, asks about another course (course_interest), or asks something that is not in the knowledge base (other). It is not a live transfer - the customer stays with you, so tell them a rep will call them back.

reason.description: Why a human rep is needed

name.description: TEST ONLY: name the customer dictated

phone.description: TEST ONLY: phone number the customer dictated, digits exactly as heard

tools.name: end_call
tools.description: End the call - only after you said your closing sentence (what happens next + goodbye); never hang up in silence, except on voicemail. Pass the reason: completed, not_interested, do_not_call (asked to be removed), voicemail (reached an answering machine - say nothing), already_registered, wrong_number.
